description: This file defines a Generator class for creating HTML documentation pages from a set of source content, utilizing templates and content type handlers. It includes methods for generating all pages, configuring themes, and processing content pages in a documentation hierarchy.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating HTML documentation pages from structured content, supporting theme customization and content type management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Generator with a Daux instance and sets up template rendering.

methods.name: getContentTypes
methods.description: Returns available content types for the generator, currently only Markdown.

methods.name: generateAll
methods.description: Generates all documentation pages, cleans the destination folder, and produces a combined HTML output.
